integrity: Known coefficient formula and previously given examples are explicitly credited; correctness rests on the all-parameter proof, not finite computations; independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only complete bipartite graphs with positive part sizes. Full-polynomial log-concavity and general multipartite families are not claimed. Earlier unindexed equivalent classifications may exist.
title: Exactly seven nonunimodal general-position polynomials of complete bipartite graphs
